title: pandas < 0.8.0 HDFStore files have Cython 32/64 bit issues
body:
``````
# Save to hdf5.
kw = dict(table=True, compression='zlib')
store = pandas.HDFStore('ADCP_series.h5', 'w')
store.put('ADCP', ADCP, **kw)
store.put('Ancillary', Anc, **kw)
store.close()

On my Enthought Python Distribution I can load it fine (also with my previous setup),

pandas.__version__
Out[2]: '0.6.1'
tables.__version__
Out[4]: '2.3.1'

But on pandas dev,
pandas.__version__
Out[8]: '0.8.0.dev'
